intern_signature.signature: fn intern_signature(ids: &mut BTreeMap<Vec<usize>, usize>, signature: &[usize]) -> usize

new.signature:
pub fn new(
        reports: Vec<usize>,
        transitions: Vec<Vec<usize>>,
        input_count: usize,
    ) -> Result<Self, MooreError>
new.obligation: Typed guard order:nonempty reports,matching row count/each input length,all targets<report count. Return exact typed error first;success owns exact input labels/rows/input count. No report arithmetic or equivalence normalization here.

reports.obligation: Borrow exact admitted report labels immutably,including usizeMAX.

transitions.obligation: Borrow exact admitted total transition matrix immutably.

input_count.obligation: Return stored alphabet size admitted against every row.

state_count.obligation: Return report vector length,n>0,not quotient block count.

initial_partition.obligation: Normalize original report values in original state order using copied usize iterator. Equal report iff equal label;canonical first-state IDs. No full report clone/input signature Vec.

refine.obligation: Private partition.len==n. One reusable scratch signature:current block followed by all successor blocks in input order. Insert/get borrowed scratch in first-state order;copy only distinct stored signature keys and append exact fresh/current ID to required output vector. Includes prior block,so refinement cannot merge. No indexing by raw class label,only by admitted state/target indices.

pair_preserves.signature: fn pair_preserves(&self, partition: &[usize], left: usize, right: usize) -> bool
pair_preserves.obligation: Private valid state indices and partition length. Unrelated classes pass immediately;related classes require equal reports and every same-input successor pair related. Boolean complement exactly old rejection predicate,with same pure usize reads/short circuit.

is_report_congruence.obligation: Wrong partition length false before indexing. Check every unordered distinct state pair in ascending state/previous order through pair_preserves;diagonal trivial and pair symmetry covers all ordered pairs. Arbitrary sparse/MAX class labels allowed as equality names. Returns congruence predicate,not coarsest partition admission.

behavioral_quotient.obligation: Start nonempty chain at canonical readout kernel. Repeat exact refinement until canonical vector unchanged;push only strict steps. Old-block inclusion ensures each strict change splits/increases class count<=n,so finite. Final map dense;each ID has first-state representative. Build quotient reports/transitions from these representatives and final map. Nonempty/shape/target invariants discharge own last/max/representative unwraps,indexing and constructor expect. Output chain/raw fields mutable;verification remains separate.

verify_quotient.obligation: Require exact readout origin. Every adjacent pair:source lengthn,exact refinement result,and strict change. Then require present last with lengthn,fixedpoint,and state_to_block identical to last. Finally compare submitted immutable quotient to actual reconstructed canonical quotient. Guards precede refine indexing;arbitrary submitted labels are compared as usize,never used as indices. Reject empty/missing-step/repeated-step/unstable/overrefined/forged-map/payload cases.

factor_surjective_quotient.signature:
pub fn factor_surjective_quotient(
        &self,
        target: &Self,
        map: &[usize],
    ) -> Result<Vec<usize>, MooreError>
factor_surjective_quotient.obligation: Ordered shape/range/onto guard then statewise report/transition homomorphism guard. Compute actual minimal map;for each source m assign target slot map[m] its minimal block. Different previous assignment explicitly refuses,otherwise fill once. Surjectivity guarantees every target slot Some before final unwrap;homomorphism kernel lies in future equivalence,so valid fibers share block. Return unique factor making factor(map(m))=minimal(m),not arbitrary map admission by replay alone.

valid_quotient_map_shape.obligation: Short-circuit same alphabet,exact source map length,all target indices in range,then image cardinality equals target cardinality. Since range already admitted,this last condition is surjectivity. Same order as old disjunctive refusal;no map indexing before length/range known.

preserves_quotient_at.signature: fn preserves_quotient_at(&self, target: &Self, map: &[usize], state: usize) -> bool
preserves_quotient_at.obligation: Private successful map-shape guard/state<n. Require same report at target image and every labeled update commutes. Known row/map bounds justify direct indices. Equivalent negation of prior statewise mismatch/any-step mismatch.

same_behavior_set.obligation: Unequal alphabets false. Build disjoint union using source offset for target transitions and exact original labels;canonical greatest relation on union yields common behavior blocks. Compare set of blocks met by each carrier (both inclusion directions),not state-count or multiplicity equality. Nonempty admitted machines preserve union typing;state+offset fits addressable live safe storage,union allocation may fail as std TCB.
